methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Gleb Tsipursky | Virginia’s AI training needs a first job at the other end - Augusta Free Press
signals.signal_reading: Opinion piece highlighting the 'chicken-and-egg' problem of AI training without job pathways reveals systemic barriers to workforce-scale AI adoption, signaling neither depth nor distribution is materializing across Virginia's labor market.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's data center cancellation in NoVA—due to local backlash, not market weakness—demonstrates the region's infrastructure dominance while community resistance may paradoxically preserve concentrated tech capital rather than distributing it.

signals.title: Virginia Tech tests thermal cameras and AI to warn drivers of animals near roads - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech deploying thermal cameras with AI for wildlife collision prevention represents practical, locally-developed application of deep technical capability outside metro hubs, signaling distributed innovation capacity in the New River Valley.

signals.title: Wide-ranging symposium to produce undergrad course on AI anxiety - UVA Today
signals.signal_reading: UVA creating undergraduate coursework on 'AI anxiety' signals shallow engagement focused on societal implications rather than technical capability-building, reflecting broad awareness without depth of implementation skills.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Governor's executive order for AI cybersecurity planning concentrates authority and strategic capability at state level, but without explicit distribution mechanisms risks amplifying existing NoVA-Richmond-academic triangle advantages in implementation capacity.
